symptoms: HTTP 500 Spike on Checkout API during flash sale. Customers unable to complete orders.
error_log: sqlalchemy.exc.TimeoutError: QueuePool limit of size 20 overflow 10 reached, connection timed out, timeout 30.00 (Background: psycopg2.OperationalError: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections)
root_cause: PostgreSQL database connection pool exhaustion caused by missing query connection timeout and unindexed user_orders lookup query during peak load.
fix: Increased DB pool size temporarily, added statement_timeout=5000ms to SQLAlchemy database engine settings, and created composite index idx_user_orders_user_id_created_at.

symptoms: Intermittent HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout on user profile page loads and setting updates.
error_log: psycopg2.OperationalError: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already. Connection pool exhausted at max_connections=200.
root_cause: PostgreSQL database connection pool exhaustion due to dangling connections from long-running analytics queries sharing the primary application DB pool without statement timeouts.
fix: Routed read-only analytics traffic to replica DB, configured pool recycling, and added statement_timeout=3000ms to user-profile-service DB config.

symptoms: Payment processing delayed and webhook processing failing with connection timed out errors.
error_log: asyncpg.exceptions.TooManyConnectionsError: sorry, too many clients already. Connection limit reached for user 'billing_app'.
root_cause: PostgreSQL database connection pool exhaustion triggered by retry loops on third-party payment gateway timeouts keeping DB connections open indefinitely.
fix: Configured PgBouncer transaction pooling mode, set max_client_conn to 1000, and capped billing service connection pool with strict socket timeouts.

symptoms: Users logged out unexpectedly; login endpoint returning HTTP 500 for 15% of auth attempts.
error_log: redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Error 111 connecting to 10.0.4.12:6379. Connection refused. Redis memory usage hit maxmemory ceiling 8GB.
root_cause: Redis session store OOM crash due to session token TTL eviction policy misconfiguration (noeviction instead of volatile-lru).
fix: Changed Redis maxmemory-policy to volatile-lru, flushed expired session keys, and scaled Redis cluster nodes.

symptoms: Push notifications and emails delayed by over 45 minutes. Kafka consumer lag growing rapidly.
error_log: org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.CommitFailedException: Commit cannot be completed since the group has already rebalanced and assigned the partitions to another member.
root_cause: Kafka consumer group rebalance storm caused by long-running email rendering batch operations blocking the heartbeats beyond max.poll.interval.ms.
fix: Decoupled email rendering into background worker threads, increased max.poll.interval.ms from 300,000ms to 600,000ms, and scaled consumer pods.

symptoms: New products not appearing in search results. Search cluster health status degraded to RED.
error_log: elasticsearch.exceptions.TransportError: 429 Too Many Requests: [es-node-03] circuit_breaking_exception: [parent] Data too large, data for [<http_request>] would be [10485760000/9.7gb], which is larger than the parent limit of [10200547328/9.5gb]
root_cause: Elasticsearch JVM Heap Out-Of-Memory due to unoptimized aggregation queries on un-mapped keyword fields coupled with a sudden bulk re-index operation.
fix: Increased Elasticsearch JVM heap size from 16GB to 32GB, enabled fielddata cache limits, and rate-limited bulk indexing requests.

symptoms: Inventory stock updates failing; order creation failing with concurrent update errors.
error_log: net.spy.memcached.OperationTimeoutException: Timeout waiting for value: waited 2500 ms. Lock wait timeout exceeded; try restarting transaction.
root_cause: Database deadlocks caused by inconsistent row locking order when reserving multiple inventory items across concurrent shopping carts.
fix: Enforced deterministic sorting by product_id prior to acquiring database row locks in inventory reservation transactions.

symptoms: Image and video uploads failing with HTTP 502 Bad Gateway across web and mobile applications.
error_log: nginx: [error] 28#28: *11452 recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer) while reading response header from upstream, client: 172.16.0.4, server: media.acme.com, request: POST /upload HTTP/1.1, upstream: http://10.0.12.44:8080/upload
root_cause: Kubernetes OOMKilled pods caused by loading full high-resolution image byte arrays directly into Node.js heap memory during image resizing without streaming.
fix: Replaced in-memory image buffer processing with stream-based processing using Sharp / libvips and increased pod memory limits from 512Mi to 2Gi.

symptoms: API Gateway returning HTTP 429 Too Many Requests for legitimate, authenticated corporate tier clients.
error_log: rate_limiter.go:128: rate limit exceeded for tenant_id=acme-corp-prod. Bucket capacity 1000 tokens depleted.
root_cause: Rate limiting redis key hash collision causing enterprise account rate limits to share bucket allocations with lower tier accounts.
fix: Updated rate limit cache key formatting to `ratelimit:{tenant_id}:{api_key_hash}` and flushed corrupted rate limit state keys.

symptoms: Product recommendation widget failing on homepage; returning HTTP 503 Service Unavailable.
error_log: grpc._channel._InactiveRpcError: <_InactiveRpcError of RPC that terminated with: status = UNAVAILABLE, details = Socket closed / DNS resolution failed for ML model inference endpoint ml-inference.internal:50051>
root_cause: CoreDNS cache poisoning and pod crash loop inside Kubernetes cluster following a network policy update.
fix: Restarted CoreDNS deployment, corrected CoreDNS configmap upstream resolver configuration, and established DNS caching sidecar.

symptoms: Real-time metrics dashboard frozen. Event stream data failing to persist in ClickHouse.
error_log: Code: 241. CLICKHOUSE_EXCEPTION: Memory limit (for query) exceeded: would use 12.40 GiB, maximum: 10.00 GiB.
root_cause: ClickHouse query memory limit exceeded during automatic nightly partition consolidation on unpartitioned event logs table.
fix: Partitioned event log table by `toYYYYMM(event_timestamp)`, increased max_memory_usage per query, and restarted ClickHouse server node.

symptoms: Checkout shipping rates calculation failing or timing out for international addresses.
error_log: httpx.ConnectTimeout: HTTP Connection pool timeout after 10.0s attempting to reach https://api.fedex-partner.com/v1/rates
root_cause: Partner shipping provider API outage combined with missing circuit breaker policy causing cascading thread pool exhaustion in shipping service.
fix: Implemented Resilience4j circuit breaker with fallback estimated shipping rates when partner API response time exceeds 1500ms.

symptoms: Support agents unable to view customer order history; search requests timing out.
root_cause: Unindexed ElasticSearch wildcard query `*query*` executed across all historical logs indices without time filter.
fix: Restricted ElasticSearch search queries to recent 30 days index wildcard and enforced mandatory filters on customer_id field.

symptoms: Single Sign-On (SSO) authentication failures across all internal employee tools.
error_log: pySAML2.error.SignatureVerificationFailed: Signature verification failed: Certificate expired at 2024-06-10T14:00:00Z
root_cause: SAML X.509 signing certificate expiration on IdP server due to un-triggered automated renewal alert.
fix: Rotated SAML signing certificate, updated Service Provider metadata, and added automated TLS/X.509 cert expiration alert at 30 days prior.

symptoms: Third-party developer webhooks dropping events; high delivery failure queue depth.
error_log: requests.exceptions.SSLError: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='client.webhook.endpoint', port=443): Max retries exceeded with url: /receiver (Caused by SSLError(SSLCertVerificationError(1, '[SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: certificate has expired')))
root_cause: Webhook dispatcher worker blockage when attempting synchronous SSL verification against misconfigured client HTTPS endpoints without per-request timeouts.
fix: Added 5s HTTP connect timeout, 10s read timeout, and offloaded failing client webhooks into exponential backoff dead-letter queue (DLQ).
